Free Cooling by Chiller Bypass in Winter
Free Cooling by Chiller Bypass in Winter

Chiller baseline consumption of month Nov, Dec & Jan is 62,146 kWh/year + Corresponding energy consumption in condenser pump & CT Fan (Evaporator Pump power will be required to circulate the water through PHE & CT). Existing decomissioned PHE at CT & Condenser water could be used.
Available ambient cooling potential is not fully utilized, so the chiller continues consuming power when free cooling could satisfy part of the thermal load.

Addional Pipe line from sump to the CT (dedicated for Chiller), Pump, Controls, Chiller auto ON/OFF, CT Water Pump auto ON/OFF (Central PLC & all sensors), Panel, Pipeline Modification, Using Existing PHE
Using ambient-assisted cooling during winter reduces compressor runtime while maintaining process cooling requirements.
